pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to quit' && sleep 2 && rm -f ~/Documents/Business_Review.key
instruction: Create a new '~/Documents/Business_Review.key'. On the 4th slide, add a pie chart that represents market share with three slices labeled 'Product A', 'Product B', and 'Product C' with values 40%, 35%, and 25% respectively. Save the presentation as a pdf.
evaluator:
[ -n "$(find ~/Documents/Business_Review.key -mmin -60)" ] && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote"
    try
        if (count of slides of document 1) is greater than or equal to 4 then
            if (count of charts of slide 4 of document 1) is greater than 0 then
                return "True"
            else
                return "False"
            end if
        else
            return "False"
        end if
    on error
        return "False"
    end try
end tell' | grep -q 'True' && echo True || echo False
